question: Does routing a single global fraction of post-F00-bypass positive agricultural net surplus through the existing 12-month source-zone SON mineralization pool improve TN prediction relative to no SON pool and to training-selected S0/S1 endpoints?
scientific_scope: generic effective cropland source-zone slow release; no manure, fertilizer, crop or source-identity attribution

parent.groundwater_delivery: T1 with mu fixed within each matched model
parent.readout: P1 globally scaled eta_quick/eta_gw and P2 station-conditioned ridge=12

operator.negative_surplus_order: withdraw mobile first, then SON, before current-month positive input
operator.monthly_order: negative withdrawal -> current positive allocation -> SON mineralization -> F00 water flushing -> quick/GW routing -> T1 release

selection.candidate: select phi_A independently inside every model x temporal fold; conservative ties choose smaller phi_A
selection.endpoint_control: independently select phi_A in {0,1} using the same training objective
selection.readout_refit: every phi_A x model x fold independently refits H1 v_f and eta_quick/eta_gw; P2 then independently refits its full frozen readout after phi_A and v_f are locked
selection.forbidden: evaluation-year TN may not affect phi_A, v_f, eta or endpoint selection

stage_1_temporal_gate.mechanistic_support: P1 station and tree comparisons against phi_A=0 must satisfy both count gates
stage_1_temporal_gate.fractional_extension_support: P1 station and tree comparisons against the training-selected {0,1} endpoint must satisfy both count gates
stage_1_temporal_gate.predictive_preservation: P2 station and tree comparisons against phi_A=0 must be noninferior in at least 5/6 models
stage_1_temporal_gate.phi_stability: at least 5/6 mu models select phi_A>0 in at least 3/4 folds
stage_1_temporal_gate.eta_or_vf_boundary: existing boundary rules remain diagnostic/confounding flags; they cannot be hidden by ensemble averaging

decision_states.PARTIAL_CROPLAND_SLOW_RELEASE_TEMPORALLY: all temporal module and fractional-extension gates pass
decision_states.SLOW_RELEASE_SUPPORTED_EXISTING_ENDPOINT: candidate improves over phi_A=0 but does not improve over the training-selected S0/S1 endpoint
decision_states.STATION_READOUT_COMPENSATED_NOT_PROCESS_: P2 passes but P1 mechanistic gate fails
decision_states.NUMERICALLY_CONFOUNDED: mass balance, endpoint nesting, optimizer or ensemble boundary contracts fail

conditional_successor: Nested LOSO/LOTO is authorized only for PARTIAL_CROPLAND_SLOW_RELEASE_TEMPORALLY_SUPPORTED_PENDING_SPATIAL; otherwise close 20260824_3 without reading 2022 TN.
